items.text: Gorgeous rosary! I have bought a few rosaries from here and every one was beautiful. Very well made, very good quality. I highly recommend to every one!!
items.name: Etsy buyer

items.text: I am really impressed with this rosary. I never had a crucifix with both a triangle on top, and the Virgin Mary with a cup too. The little details of the center medal, the picture of my beloved santa Teresita, and the Paternoster beads make this a big beautiful labour of love.
items.name: Carlos

items.text: This was a gift for my eleven-year-old goddaughter, who was absolutely delighted to receive it. These are her words: I love that every bead has a different pattern and I love that it says something on the back of the cross and around Mary. I will keep it forever!
items.name: Jude

items.text: Beautiful rosary beads - so happy with them! Perfect size :)
items.name: Anne
